1.

The prayer made in the instant petition is for a direction to respondents no.3 and 4 to decide the applications of the petitioners dated 10.07.2024, 12.08.2024 and 03.09.2024 under Section 64 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (in short the 'Act') within a specified time and pay arrears of compensation to them according to report of revenue authorities dated 19.10.2022.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the petitioners had earlier approached this Court by filing Writ-C No. 17240 of 2024 (Ramasare and 3 others vs. State of U.P. and 7 others) and the said writ petition was disposed of with liberty to the petitioners to avail the remedy of reference under Section 64 of the Act.

entities.text: Writ-C No. 17240 of 2024 (Ramasare and 3 others vs. State of U.P. and 7 others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In pursuance of the same, petitioners moved an application before the respondent no.4 for reference but no decision has been taken in the matter so far.
3. Sri Sarvesh Pandey, Advocate holding brief of Sri Ishan Deo Giri, learned counsel for the respondent no.2 is present.
He has no objection in case the prayer made in the petition is granted.

4. Accordingly, the petition is disposed of with a direction to respondent no.3 to pass appropriate orders on the applications of the petitioners dated 10.07.2024, 12.08.2024 and 03.09.2024 within four weeks from the date of communication of the instant order.

Order Date :- 9.12.2024 Ashish Pd.
